summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) with a B.E. in Electronics & Telecommunication and hands-on PCB hardware design experience across analog and digital circuit design, schematic capture, and embedded 8/16-bit/ARM microcontroller development. Skilled in debugging and prototyping embedded systems using oscilloscopes and logic analyzers, with direct experience fabricating and verifying production-style circuit boards.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE — schematic capture, analog circuit design, and digital circuit design — for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.
Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB hardware design, and embedded systems integration end-to-end.
Organized 10+ exhibitions and technical workshops covering Arduino, PCB design, and SolidWorks.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometer sensing technology with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth, translating 3-DoF motion into HID commands via Python.

Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning during debugging and prototyping of embedded systems.
Architected a Mixed Reality headset concept using real-time chroma keying; produced full claims documentation and BOM.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Built Cortex-M4 embedded microcontroller firmware in bare-metal C with timer-synchronized ADC sensing and real-time display for embedded 8/16-bit/ARM microcontroller development.
Implemented timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver, programming GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, and I2C1 peripherals directly.

Achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at deterministic 1 Hz update rate; applied design verification testing to industry standards via Proteus circuit simulation as part of production validation fixture and procedure development before hardware bring-up.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Designed multi-servo PWM control circuit with interrupt-driven UART commands between NVIDIA Jetson and STM32 microcontroller for real-time object tracking.
Integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing technology and OLED distance visualization; used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination.

awards: Ranked 10th, Robocon - National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
1st Prize, CanSat Workshop - Arduino Nano atmospheric data collection during free fall (2023)
